title.en: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty

headline.en: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty: hear the whole song first, then the tune on its own.

detail.en: The whole song, every part together
detail.es: La canción entera, con todas las voces

detail.en: The guide sings it, line by line
detail.es: La guía la canta frase a frase

text.en: Find the notes of line 1: each one waits until you're on it.
text.es: Busca las notas de la frase 1: cada una te espera hasta que estés en ella.

text.en: The German hymn, Lobe den Herren, was the favourite of King Friedrich Wilhelm III of Prussia. The writer Lauxmann relates how he was affected by hearing it sung in a boat in the mines at Waldenburg in 1800.

source.en: John Julian, A Dictionary of Hymnology (1907), vol. 1, p. 683, "Lobe den Herren", citing Lauxmann, read from the scan

text.en: Hear line 1, then sing it back.
text.es: Escucha la frase 1 y repítela.

text.en: Line 2 is the tune of line 1 again, with new words. Sing it with the guide.
text.es: La frase 2 repite la melodía de la frase 1, con otra letra. Cántala con la guía.

text.en: Hear line 3, then sing it back.
text.es: Escucha la frase 3 y repítela.

text.en: Now lines 1 to 3 joined, with the guide.
text.es: Ahora las frases 1 a 3 seguidas, con la guía.

text.en: Hear line 4, then sing it back.
text.es: Escucha la frase 4 y repítela.

text.en: Hear line 5, then sing it back.
text.es: Escucha la frase 5 y repítela.

text.en: Line 6 is the tune of line 1 again, with new words. Sing it with the guide.
text.es: La frase 6 repite la melodía de la frase 1, con otra letra. Cántala con la guía.

text.en: Line 7 is the tune of line 1 again, with new words. Sing it with the guide.
text.es: La frase 7 repite la melodía de la frase 1, con otra letra. Cántala con la guía.

text.en: Now lines 4 to 7 joined, with the guide.
Line 8 is the tune of line 3 again, with new words. Sing it with the guide.
Line 9 is the tune of line 4 again, with new words. Sing it with the guide.
Hear line 10, then sing it back.
text.es: Escucha la frase 10 y repítela.

text.en: Now lines 8 to 10 joined, with the guide.
text.es: Ahora las frases 8 a 10 seguidas, con la guía.

text.en: Verse 1 start to end, with the guide.
text.es: La estrofa 1 de principio a fin, con la guía.

text.en: Verse 2 start to end, with the guide.
text.es: La estrofa 2 de principio a fin, con la guía.

text.en: The whole song, with the guide.
text.es: La canción entera, con la guía.

text.en: Sing your part with the other parts, and the guide with you. Hold your line while the others move.
text.es: Canta tu parte con las demás voces, y la guía contigo. Mantente firme en ella mientras las otras se mueven.

text.en: The guide drops out: your part with the others only. Give me my note plays your first note quietly.
text.es: La guía deja de cantar: tu parte, solo con las demás voces. "Escuchar mi nota" te da tu primera nota, suave.

text.en: Once more on your own, from the top.
text.es: Otra vez sin guía, desde el principio.

text.en: Record the tune of Praise to the Lord, the Almighty in Sing, with the other parts playing.
With this hymn the Prussian War Minister, Albrecht von Roon, celebrated his jubilee of service, near Paris, on January 9, 1871.

source.en: John Julian, A Dictionary of Hymnology (1907), vol. 1, p. 683, "Lobe den Herren", read from the scan
